claims: The Detroit Tigers opened their 2026 home season with a 4-0 shutout victory against the St. Louis Cardinals at Comerica Park on Friday, April 3, 2026.
Left-handed pitcher Framber Valdez threw six scoreless innings.
The win broke a four-game losing streak for the Detroit Tigers.
The Detroit Tigers are 3-4 on the season.
The venue was Comerica Park, Detroit, Michigan.
Framber Valdez was the starting pitcher.
The Detroit Tigers season record is 3-4 after Opening Day.
The game was at 1:10 p.m. ET.
The Detroit Tigers opened their overall season on the road in San Diego on March 26.
